RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from this information.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Your longer experience merits consideration, but digital expertise, leadership, interview performance and editorial strategy could legitimately outweigh years served.

Follow up your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment and the applicable review procedure. Check any complaint deadlines now; waiting for feedback may not extend them.

Raise a discrimination concern if you uncover specific evidence—sex-related comments, inconsistent standards or departures from the recruitment process—not simply the panel’s composition. Neither the appointment nor the panel’s sex establishes unfairness.
